qa_pairs.question: What products does OrbitTech sell?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: OrbitTech sells four primary devices: NovaBook 14 laptop, PulsePhone X smartphone, AeroBuds Pro wireless earbuds, and HomeHub Mini home-automation controller.

contexts.text: OrbitTech sells four primary fictional devices.
The NovaBook 14 is a 14-inch laptop with two USB-C ports, one USB-A port, 16 GB of memory, and a 512 GB solid-state drive.
The PulsePhone X is a dual-SIM smartphone with one physical nano-SIM slot and one eSIM profile active at a time.
The AeroBuds Pro are wireless earbuds supplied with a charging case and three ear-tip sizes.
The HomeHub Mini is a home-automation controller that requires 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi for initial setup.

qa_pairs.question: Can I cancel my OrbitTech order after it starts packing?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: An order can be cancelled from the account page while its status is Confirmed. Once the status becomes Packing, cancellation is no longer guaranteed. Support may request a carrier interception, but interception fees are non-refundable and success is not guaranteed.

contexts.text: An order can be cancelled from the account page while its status is `Confirmed`.
Once the status becomes `Packing`, cancellation is no longer guaranteed.

qa_pairs.question: What is the return window for an opened device ordered after September 1, 2026?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: For orders placed on or after September 1, 2026, an opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee. A defective device verified during the return window is not charged a restocking fee.

contexts.text: For orders placed on or after September 1, 2026, an unopened standard device may be returned within 30 calendar days after confirmed delivery.
An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee.
A defective device verified during the return window is not charged a restocking fee.

qa_pairs.question: What are the key benefits of OrbitPlus membership?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: OrbitPlus members receive free standard shipping on eligible domestic orders, a 5% member discount on regularly priced OrbitTech accessories, and priority chat support. It does NOT discount devices, repair charges, gift cards, taxes, express shipping, or clearance products.

contexts.text: Active members receive free standard shipping on eligible domestic orders, a 5% member discount on regularly priced OrbitTech accessories, and priority chat support.
Membership does not discount devices, repair charges, gift cards, taxes, express shipping, or products already marked as clearance.

qa_pairs.question: What information is required to request a repair?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A repair request requires the product serial number, contact information, symptoms, and proof of purchase when warranty coverage is requested. Remote support may run diagnostics before authorizing shipment or store intake.

contexts.text: A repair request requires the product serial number, contact information, symptoms, and proof of purchase when warranty coverage is requested.

qa_pairs.question: How long does a typical repair take at OrbitTech?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Initial diagnosis takes up to three business days after receipt. A covered repair takes up to ten additional business days when parts are available. If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review.

contexts.text: Initial diagnosis normally takes up to three business days after the service centre receives the product.
A covered repair normally takes up to ten additional business days when parts are available.
If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy.

qa_pairs.question: What should I do if I suspect unauthorized access to my account?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Reset your password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security. If an unauthorized order is still Confirmed, attempt cancellation. If already packing or dispatched, Account Security will coordinate with relevant teams.

contexts.text: A customer who suspects account compromise should reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security.
If an unauthorized order is still `Confirmed`, the customer should also attempt cancellation under `02_orders_and_payments.md`.
If it is already packing or dispatched, Account Security coordinates with the Payments and Delivery teams; cancellation or interception is not guaranteed.

qa_pairs.question: What happens if I miss an OrbitPay instalment payment?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A failed instalment receives a seven-calendar-day retry period. Continued failure may suspend the account from new instalment purchases but does not remotely disable the device.

contexts.text: A failed instalment receives a seven-calendar-day retry period; continued failure may suspend the account from new instalment purchases but does not remotely disable the device.

Orders placed before September 1 keep the 21-day window regardless of membership.

qa_pairs.question: Can I combine multiple promotional codes for extra savings?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. Only one percentage-off promotional code may be applied to an order. A percentage code may be combined with a gift card, but not with another percentage code or a clearance markdown. A fixed-value service credit may be combined with one percentage code unless its terms say otherwise.

contexts.text: Only one percentage-off promotional code may be applied to an order.

qa_pairs.question: What are the delivery requirements for high-value orders?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Orders containing devices valued above USD 1,000 require an adult signature. Carrier pickup may be requested after the first failed delivery attempt, but the carrier may require ID matching the shipment name. OrbitTech does not authorize leaving signature-required packages unattended.

contexts.text: Orders containing devices valued above USD 1,000 require an adult signature.
A customer may request carrier pickup after the first failed delivery attempt, but the carrier may require identification matching the shipment name.
OrbitTech does not authorize a carrier to leave a signature-required package unattended.

qa_pairs.question: When can OrbitTech deny a warranty claim?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The warranty excludes: loss, theft, cosmetic wear, depleted consumables, accidental impact, liquid exposure, electrical damage from an unsupported charger, unauthorized modification, and repair by a non-authorized provider. It also excludes failures caused solely by third-party networks, applications, accessories, or compatibility changes.

contexts.text: The warranty excludes loss, theft, cosmetic wear, depleted consumables, accidental impact, liquid exposure, electrical damage from an unsupported charger, unauthorized modification, and repair by a non-authorized provider.

qa_pairs.question: My device stopped working 3 years after flood damage occurred. Can I get warranty replacement since the failure just happened?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Warranty coverage depends on when the device was purchased and delivered, not when the failure occurred. The warranty excludes liquid exposure damage. Since flood damage is explicitly excluded from warranty coverage regardless of when the failure happens, this would not qualify as a warranty claim.

contexts.text: The assistant may describe a policy but cannot view a live order, issue a refund, approve a warranty claim, unlock an account, change a delivery address, or promise an exception.
Coverage begins on confirmed delivery for shipped orders and on collection for store-pickup orders.

The warranty excludes loss, theft, cosmetic wear, depleted consumables, accidental impact, liquid exposure, electrical damage from an unsupported charger, unauthorized modification, and repair by a non-authorized provider.
